purpose: Verify the exact selected Gemini key -> Google project -> billing-disabled chain after Google OAuth credential was reconnected.
execution_constraints: Use a fresh diagnostic ID, runner, and output receipt; preserve all earlier diagnostic receipts.
Export only the two named credentials to temporary mode-0600 files; never print or persist credential secrets.
Capture only a restricted, sanitized provider error code on rejection; never store response bodies, tokens, or key strings.
Delete temporary credential exports after completion.
stop_conditions: Stop after any non-200 response, transport error, malformed response, or identity mismatch.
Stop unless the key-owner lookup identifies exactly one project.
Stop unless billingInfo.projectId matches and billingEnabled is false.
Never retry a failed or ambiguous call.

execution_result.stop_reason: OAuth refreshed successfully; the connected Google identity lacks access for the API key owner lookup, or the token lacks the required Cloud Platform scope. No further calls made.

next_access_requirement.note: Official Google documentation lists these requirements; the 403 alone does not distinguish missing IAM permission from insufficient OAuth scope.
